blocks.x: Well, did he have, this is another question, did he have, what type of relationship did he have with the New Orleans Jazz Club?

Well, he had a close relationship with Myra Menzel. And she was the secretary of the club. She used to keep in touch with them and all that. And, but of course all the rest of the people, he didn't even know. He knew Harry Sushant kind of. But anyway, and he knew Sherwood Manjapani, who he liked very much.
That he and Sherwood corresponded, they talked a lot about.
Yeah. And, of course Sherwood is the world's biggest Armstrong collector. Yeah, right.
I, since I found out. Yeah.
